about_the_game:
All the Management Tasks You Expect and More

Recruit and train your employees, research new recipes, expand your store, run advertisements, stock up on new baking equipment, fill the shelves with a variety of pastries and bread, and tastefully decorate your bakery. Your goal is to provide customers with unforgettable experiences every time they visit.

What Makes Us Special: STORIES!

You are recruited by a gang member who initially planned for a money-laundering operation. However, as an ambitious manager, you see the potential for this bakery to thrive. Explore the neighborhood after the store closes: talk to neighbors and customers, assist them, and unlock their stories. You might find yourself deeply involved with the community and falling in love with this charming little bakery.

Cute and Funny Special Customers

Attract special customers like a grumpy yet amusing old bird or the adorable yet soulful puppies. These unique customers are not easy to lure in! Discover their preferences and cater to them. Whether it’s the right ads, the perfect bakery products, or special decorations, make them feel welcome. As a reward, they’ll display unique behaviors.

Mini Games

Although it’s a management game, you’ll have the chance to bake food yourself or select a deck of bakery cards to compete with gourmet enthusiasts. You can also host thematic festivals in the game periodically... More games under development!

name: Animal Bakery

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® XP (32-64 bits) /Windows Vista®(32-64 bits)/Windows 7® (32-64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core® 2 Duo 1.8 GHZ or AMD Athlon X2 64 2.4GHZ
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 256 MB DirectX® 9.0–compliant card with Shader Model 3.0 or higher (see supported list)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0 –compliant sound card

short_description: Managing a bakery as an undercover for a local animal gang isn't easy. Hire staff, research new recipes, expand the store, and attract special customers. But you might wonder: Which is the better life? Running a successful bakery or letting the thug life choose you?
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
